title: Fish Bottle Opener
description: A chunky cartoon fish with a lever-style bottle opener opening in its belly and a key-ring hole in its tail.
use: Pop crown caps off glass bottles; hangs on a key ring. Prototype geometry: hold the fish flat, hook the lip under the cap edge and lever up.
material: PETG (tougher than PLA), 0.2 mm layers, 5 perimeters, 100% infill. Print flat. Not test-printed: strength and the exact catch lip may need a revision.
